name: Solar PV with a battery in Greece: charging from the PV only (par. 11A) or also from the grid (par. 11B)
description: How the two types of station with integrated storage in article 10 of Law 4685/2020 differ: charging from the grid, licensing act, injection limit, basis of the letter of guarantee and the cap per group.
creator: Ariadne Labs

rows.Par. 11A: charging from the PV only: no, except for the station's auxiliary consumption
40% of the PV plant's installed power from 07:00 to 19:00
rows.Par. 11B: charging also from the grid: the hourly limits of Β΄ 3328/2023 for storage stations on the transmission system

rows.Topic: Power used for the letter of guarantee
500 MW cap per group on batteries until 2029
